Perfect! I've successfully implemented the automatic submission feature for example prompts. Here's what I changed:

## Summary of Changes

I modified the `handleExamplePromptSelect` function in `src/App.tsx` to automatically submit example prompts when clicked, instead of just selecting them.

### Key Changes:

1. **Auto-submission Logic**: The function now:
   - Sets the query in the input field briefly for visual feedback
   - Automatically submits the prompt after a 100ms delay
   - Follows the same submission pattern as the manual submit handler

2. **Enhanced User Experience**: 
   - Users will see the prompt appear in the input field momentarily
   - Then it automatically submits without requiring an additional click
   - All the same validation and error handling applies

3. **Maintained Functionality**: 
   - Still validates that submission is allowed (`canSubmit`)
   - Still trims whitespace and validates non-empty prompts
   - Still handles errors gracefully with system messages
   - Still plays error sounds on failure

### Technical Implementation:

```typescript
const handleExamplePromptSelect = useCallback(
  async (prompt: string) => {
    if (!appState.canSubmit || !prompt.trim()) return;

    const trimmedPrompt = prompt.trim();
    console.log("🚀 Auto-submitting example prompt:", trimmedPrompt);

    // Set the query briefly for UI feedback, then submit
    conversation.setQuery(trimmedPrompt);
    scrolling.autoScrollToBottom(true);
    
    // Auto-submit after a brief delay to show the query in the input
    setTimeout(async () => {
      appState.setIsProcessing(true);
      conversation.addUserMessage(trimmedPrompt);
      conversation.setQuery("");

      try {
        await invoke("submit_query", { query: trimmedPrompt });
        console.log("✅ Example prompt submitted successfully");
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("❌ Failed to submit example prompt:", error);
        conversation.addSystemMessage(`Failed to submit prompt: ${error}`);
        appState.setIsProcessing(false);
        playError();
      }
    }, 100); // Brief delay to show the prompt in the input field
  },
  [
    appState.canSubmit,
    appState.setIsProcessing,
    conversation.setQuery,
    conversation.addUserMessage,
    conversation.addSystemMessage,
    scrolling.autoScrollToBottom,
    playError,
  ]
);
```

The development server is now running to test the functionality. Now when users click any example prompt, it will automatically:

1. ✅ Show the prompt in the input field  
2. ✅ Submit it automatically after 100ms
3. ✅ Start the AI agent processing
4. ✅ Handle any errors gracefully

This creates a much smoother user experience - users can simply click an example prompt and it will immediately start executing without needing a second click to submit!
